_matrixAnalyse: Conversion is concentrated on the training intent. 'Data analyst' (74 clk, CVR 2.8%) drives volume, but the bootcamp format converts better : 'data analyst bootcamp' (5 clk, CVR 20.0%) and 'bootcamp data analyst' (2 clk, CVR 50.0%) show that structured, intensive programmes are what this audience actually wants. 'Data analysis course' (2 clk + 6 clk, CVR 50.0% + 16.7%) confirms programme-based intent. Pattern B : 'business analysis certification' (3 clk, CVR 0%) — certification is on the radar but the page does not address it. Naming tools explicitly (Power BI, SQL, Tableau) in the page is critical — these users are comparison-shopping bootcamps.
